title: campanula rotundifolia var. scheuchzeri
intro: Campanula rotundifolia var. scheuchzeri, commonly known as Alpine Bellflower, is a plant species that belongs to the Campanulaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing, making it a valuable asset in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Bellflower include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of using Alpine Bellflower include reducing fever, soothing digestive issues, and supporting cardiovascular health, although more research is needed to confirm its efficacy.
